items.title: Ukraine Is Winning Its War On Russian Oil Refineries. On The Front Line, It's A Bloody Slugfest.
items.description: Ukraine’s drone campaign on Russian gasoline refineries is wreaking havoc, leading to nationwide shortages, fraying tempers, and mounting headaches for the Kremlin. On the battlefield, however, Ukraine’s troops face a grim fight. Look at what’s happening in Kostyantynivka.

items.title: Dayslong funeral for slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei begins in Tehran
items.description: Khamenei, who ruled Iran for more than three decades, was killed in an airstrike on Feb. 28 at the start of the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

items.title: How the Russian army lost its military advantage against Ukraine
items.description: Russia is becoming bogged down in the ground war and falling further behind technologically, while its human and oil resources dwindle. The Ukrainian army, supported by an innovative defense industry, has nevertheless been unable to switch to an offensive posture in ground combat.

items.title: Sudan’s people subject to ‘relentless’ drone strikes in El Obeid
items.description: The war in Sudan threatens to spiral further as the strategically-important town of El Obeid continues to face “relentless” drone attacks by advancing paramilitary militias, the UN’s human rights chief, Volker Türk, said on Friday.

items.title: AI drones made in Germany see duty on Ukraine's front line
items.description: The German defense company Helsing is supplying combat drones to Ukraine and will soon provide them to the German army. How effective are they on the front line? DW joined a Ukrainian combat mission to find out.

items.title: From ‘greatest friend’ to ‘loser’: US-Iran deal sours many Israelis on Trump
items.description: Israeli attitudes toward U.S. President Donald Trump, once seen as the nation’s savior, have shifted dramatically. The initial U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal is already seen as a blow to Israel’s strategy and standing, and the backlash on the Israeli right has been harsh.
